snippet.title: BALL x PIT can't get better, right? The Shadow Update is Now Available
snippet.description:
BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update is out now and FREE for all players
http://www.ballxpit.com

BALL x PIT: The Shadow Update, brings new balls, a new building, new characters, and new passives to your favorite time-devouring, ball-bouncing roguelite.
